verdict.rationale: Kit's first-party docs describe a full webhook system. Integrations register an endpoint and react to account activity in real time instead of polling, with documented event types such as subscriber.unsubscribed and subscriber.bounced. Every delivery is signed with the endpoint's secret for verification, and failed deliveries are retried with backoff up to 8 attempts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook subscriptions work as documented.
